notes: Company profile: mid-market B2B SaaS (developer-focused), product: code search + contextual code snippets for enterprises.
Primary need: fast, cost-efficient embeddings pipeline + sub-100ms top-k semantic search for UI queries.
Current stack: indexes in Pinecone, ingest pipeline via Airflow + S3, consumer-facing queries through a Go service.
Scale: ~200k new vectors/day at peak; nightly batch reindex (~3M vectors) and incremental real-time inserts (~1-5k vectors/min).
Latency target: <100ms end-to-end for 10-50 vector nearest-neighbor queries (including network + vector DB lookup).
Throughput target: sustained 800 embeddings/sec during bulk ingest windows; real-time 50 qps for search with p99 <200ms.
Cost sensitivity: high — looking to reduce per-vector cost by 40-60% vs current Hosted baseline. Team asked for explicit cost model for Dedicated vs Hosted.
Model preferences: open to Llama-derivatives + 6/13B quantized options; higher accuracy on code embeddings preferred over smallest size.
Routing/fallback: want automatic fallback to cheaper quantized variant during high ingest, with observable quality regressions.
Security: must support SSO/SAML for console, KMS for key management, and audit logs forwarded to their SIEM; data residency for EU customers.
Quote from CTO: "We need predictable cost for our nightly jobs. If Dedicated gives a 2-3x improvement in unit cost, we'll commit."
Procurement note: prefers annual commit; legal flagged standard DPAs — awaiting Redwood enterprise terms.
Integration asks: native connector for Pinecone or a validated pattern for streaming embeddings into their existing index; also Kafka sink for near-real-time flows.
Success criteria for POC: 1) Dedicated throughput >= 800 emb/sec for 1 hour, 2) end-to-end search p99 <=200ms for 50 qps, 3) 40% cost reduction per vector (projected).
Internal: SE to run 2 additional dedicated node configs (g4dn-like and a40-like) and produce comparative throughput/cost table by 2025-02-21.

poc_results_summary: Hosted baseline: embeddings average 32ms/vector (single-threaded), bulk ingest peak 420 emb/sec when parallelized across workers; extrapolated cost higher than target.
Dedicated run (preliminary on small nodes): 780 emb/sec sustained for 15 minutes with 18% lower per-vector cost; still short of 40% target — larger instance types to test.
Search latency: end-to-end median 85ms on hosted baseline for single shard + Pinecone lookup; p99 spikes to 320ms under concurrent load (50 qps) — needs optimization.
Integrator notes: network hop to Pinecone adds 40-60ms; exploring options: colocated vector DB (dedicated) or batching lookups to reduce RPC overhead.
Next POC step: full-nightly index run simulation on Dedicated nodes (3 hours) + cost forecast for 12-month reserved capacity.
